text:
This notice should be read with the UK regulations implementing the provisions of the Maritime Labour Convention, 2006, as amended (MLC).

Notice to:

shipowners

masters

seafarers

recruitment and placement services

The purpose of the marine guidance notice is to explain the UK’s understanding of the key terms used in the MLC.

The UK intends to implement the MLC and all amendments fully and without departing from the intention of those who drafted the convention.

The terms covered in this notice are “seafarer,” “ship” and “shipowner.”

Amendment 2 updates the definition of seafarer to cover special purpose ships.
